fact: The apex of the Southern Triangle — an orange giant marking the deep south.
bio: Atria (Alpha Trianguli Australis) is an orange giant roughly 390 light-years away, the brightest star of Triangulum Australe, the Southern Triangle.
cultural: Its name is simply a contraction of its Bayer designation, 'Alpha Trianguli Australis'. The Southern Triangle was among the constellations introduced by the navigators who charted the far-southern sky in the late 16th century.
